# keychain_internet_password (Data Source)

Reads an internet password item from the macOS Keychain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an existing internet password from the macOS Keychain
data "keychain_internet_password" "example" {
  server   = "api.example.com"
  account  = "existing-user"
  protocol = "https"
}

output "password" {
  value     = data.keychain_internet_password.example.password
  sensitive = true
}

output "port" {
  value = data.keychain_internet_password.example.port
}

output "path" {
  value = data.keychain_internet_password.example.path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The account name/username (kSecAttrAccount).
- `port` (Number) The port number. Use 0 for any port.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol (http, https, ftp, ssh, smb, afp, ldap, ldaps).
- `server` (String) The server hostname (kSecAttrServer).

### Read-Only

- `authentication_type` (String) The authentication type (httpBasic, httpDigest, htmlForm, default).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this data source (server:account:protocol:port).
- `label` (String) The human-readable label for the item.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password data.
- `path` (String) The URL path.
- `security_domain` (String) The security domain.
